class.name: YAML
class.brief_description: Converts between YAML text and Godot data structures.
class.description: Main interface for working with YAML in Godot, providing methods to parse, validate, and serialize YAML data. [url=https://yaml.org/]YAML (YAML Ain't Markup Language)[/url] is a human-friendly data serialization standard commonly used for configuration files, data exchange, and storing structured information in a readable format. This class automatically handles conversion between YAML and standard Godot variant types, except for [Callable] and [RID].

method.name: allow_resource_path
method.description: Allows resource loading from a specific path prefix for the default security instance. If [param type_names] is empty, allows all non-blocked resource types from this path. This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance. For more control, create a custom [YAMLSecurity] instance using [method create_security]. By default there are no path restrictions, but [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code] resource types are blocked for security reasons. Path prefixes can include wildcards ([code]*[/code] for a single segment, [code]**[/code] for multiple segments).

method.name: block_resource_type
method.description: Blocks a specific resource type globally for the default security instance. Any resource of this type (or inheriting from it) will be rejected during parsing. This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance. For more control, create a custom [YAMLSecurity] instance using [method create_security].

method.name: create_security
method.description: Creates a new [YAMLSecurity] configuration object for controlling resource loading during YAML parsing. This allows for fine-grained control over which resources can be loaded from which paths and of which types.

method.name: create_style
method.description:
Creates a new [YAMLStyle] configuration object for customizing YAML serialization. This allows control over aspects like string quoting, flow style, and number formatting. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Create a custom style for YAML output var style = YAML.create_style() # Use literal style for multiline strings style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_LITERAL) # Or, for example, ensure all strings are double-quoted # style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE)
# Convert data to YAML with custom style var data = { "name": "Player", "description": "A player character with a\nmultiline description.", "inventory": ["Sword", "Shield", "Potion"] } var result = YAML.stringify(data, style) if !result.has_error(): print(result.get_data()) # Example output with STRING_LITERAL: # name: Player # description: | # A player character with a # multiline description. # inventory: # - Sword # - Shield # - Potion [/codeblock]

method.name: has_registered_class
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a class with the given [param script_class] name is registered for custom YAML serialization/deserialization, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: load_file
parse
method.description:
Parses a YAML string into Godot data structures. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data or error information. If [param security] is provided, it will be used to validate resource loading. Otherwise, the default security settings will be used. If [param detect_style] is [code]true[/code], the method attempts to detect and store style information. This style can be retrieved using [method YAMLResult.get_style] and used to preserve formatting when re-serializing. Multi-document YAML (documents separated by [code]---[/code]) is fully supported. Each document can be accessed individually through [method YAMLResult.get_document] or [method YAMLResult.get_data] using an index. Use [method YAMLResult.get_document_count] to find out how many documents were parsed. [b]Note:[/b] The [param detect_style] parameter has no effect in multi-document YAML files. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var yaml_string = """ player: name: Hero level: 10 inventory: - Sword - Shield """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) if result.has_error(): print("Error parsing YAML: ", result.get_error()) else: var data = result.get_data() # For single document, index 0 is implicit print("Player name: ", data.player.name) [/codeblocks]

method.name: register_class
reset_security
method.description: Resets the default security settings to their original state. This clears all custom path allowances and type blockages, then re-adds the default blocked types ([code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code]). This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance.

method.name: save_file
stringify
method.description:
Converts Godot [param data] to YAML text. Returns a [YAMLResult]. On success, the result's data will contain the generated YAML string. On failure, it will contain error information. If [param style] (a [YAMLStyle] instance) is provided, it will be used to customize the formatting of the YAML output. Otherwise, default formatting will be used. [codeblock lang="gdscript"] # Convert dictionary to YAML var data = { "name": "Stranger", "dialogue": ["Hello, traveler.", "What brings you here?"] }
var result = YAML.stringify(data) if !result.has_error(): var yaml_text = result.get_data() print(yaml_text) # Example output: # name: Stranger # dialogue: # - Hello, traveler. # - What brings you here? [/codeblock]

method.name: try_load_file
method.description: Simplified version of [method load_file] that returns [null] on error and automatically reports errors through Godot's error reporting system.

method.name: try_parse
method.description: Simplified version of [method parse] that returns [null] on error and automatically reports errors through Godot's error reporting system.

method.name: try_save_file
method.description: Simplified version of [method save_file] that returns [false] error and automatically reports errors through Godot's error reporting system.

method.name: try_stringify
method.description: Simplified version of [method stringify] that returns [null] error and automatically reports errors through Godot's error reporting system.

method.name: unregister_class
method.description: Unregisters a previously registered custom script class (via [param script_class] which must be a [Script] resource) from YAML serialization and deserialization. After unregistering, instances of this class will be serialized as generic Godot objects or dictionaries if possible, without the custom YAML tag.

method.name: validate
method.description: Validates YAML syntax of the given [param yaml_text] string without performing a full parse into Godot data structures. Returns a [YAMLResult]; if [method YAMLResult.has_error] is [code]false[/code], the YAML is syntactically valid. Otherwise, error information can be retrieved. This method is faster than [method parse] if you only need to check for syntactic validity and do not need the parsed data.

method.name: validate_file
method.description: Validates YAML syntax in a file at the given [param path] without performing a full parse. Returns a [YAMLResult] indicating success or containing error information. This method is useful for quickly checking if a YAML file is well-formed.

method.name: version
method.description: Returns the version of the YAML GDExtension as a string, typically including version number and build information (e.g., "Godot YAML 0.12.1 (release)").
